title: Salary Data for Child Protection Officers
what_it_is: Salary Data for Child Protection Officers

sections.label: Child protection officer allowance
sections.summary: Child protection officers receive an additional social work field allowance in recognition of the more demanding nature of their work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In recognition of the more demanding nature of child protection work, our CPOs also receive an additional social work field allowance.

sections.label: Mean and median salaries
sections.summary: Exact salary points cannot be given because officers have different years of service and seniority levels in the Public Service.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: To his first question on the mean and median salaries, it is not quite possible for us to look at exact numbers, exact salary points, because we are talking about a range of officers with different years in service, with different seniority levels in the Public Service.

sections.label: CPO training and wellness support
sections.summary: Child protection officers undergo a comprehensive training programme and receive professional support on mental wellness and development through supervisions, coaching and peer support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: To support the growth and the wellness of our CPOs, I mentioned before that they undergo a comprehensive training programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: They also receive professional support on mental wellness and development, through structured supervisions, coaching as well as peer support.

sections.label: Technology for CPO workload
sections.summary: Technology such as data analytics and robotic process automation has been implemented to optimise operations so officers focus on child protection rather than administration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: To address the workload of our CPOs, to help them work more effectively and more efficiently, we have also tried our level best to implement solutions, including technology, such as data analytics, robotic process automation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: These tools are really meant to optimise our operations, so that they can focus on the core mission and, that is, child protection; and less so on the more mundane tasks of administration.

sections.label: Caseload number 40 too high
sections.summary: In previous Sittings the question was whether 40 is the right number, and the speaker agreed with Mr Louis Ng that 40 is too high.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: In previous Sittings, we were talking about whether 40 is the right number and, 40 is too high.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: I remember agreeing with Mr Louis Ng that 40 is a number that is too high.

sections.label: Average caseload per officer
sections.summary: The average caseload each officer handles is 40 or less, based on a check with CPS before the Sitting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: I would be happy to share more details if I can.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: But I think off the top of my head, I had checked in with CPS before coming to this Sitting and the average caseload that each officer handles is 40 or less.
